test_read_parquet: test the read_parquet function to load parquet files into pandas DataFrames with engine and dtype_backend options
test_to_parquet: test the to_parquet function to write pandas DataFrames to parquet files with compression and partition options
test_get_engine: test the get_engine function to retrieve pyarrow or fastparquet engine implementations with deprecation warnings
test_round_trip: test the check_round_trip function to verify parquet serialization and deserialization produce identical DataFrames
test_partition_names: test the check_partition_names function to verify hive partition column names in a parquet dataset directory
